summary: Adds a new file skills/debug-loop/evals/eval_queries.json: a JSON array of 20 trigger-eval entries for the debug-loop skill. Each entry pairs a user query with a should_trigger boolean. Eleven positive cases cover build failures, red tests, tracebacks, CI logs, regressions, intermittent bugs, performance regressions, and retry-after-failure. Nine negative cases cover feature additions, PR review, refactoring, TDD, error-handling cleanup, code explanation, lint noise, brainstorming, and theory questions.
